dataset: Directory of Federal Real Property (DFRP) open dataset

record_count: DND custodian (code DND, 'National Defence'): 736 parcels, all 'canadian' location type; 702 with coordinates; land area total 2,191,653 ha
validation_notes: sha256 e3e9cbd188f2c64092202e7e746ff5c45e8d2adbae37afb8b9878a9c66e97921. POINTS ONLY (one lat/lon per parcel plus land area), no boundaries; used as a proxy (equal-area circle around each parcel point, parcels >= 100 ha).
